rows: Rosenau: managing global issues through norms, institutions, and coordination without a central enforcement authority
Why is the Paris Agreement designed with NDCs?
Previous top-down targets (Kyoto) failed because key states (US, China) wouldn't accept binding commitments; NDC model is bottom-up — countries set their own pace
What is ICANN and why does it matter?
Manages DNS and IP allocation; key internet governance body; China/Russia want ITU (UN intergovernmental) to replace it — the governance fight is about state control vs. multi-stakeholder
Fragmented internet with incompatible national versions; content/application layer increasingly fragmented (China's Great Firewall); TCP/IP layer still globally interoperable
Libya 2011 used it for regime change; Russia/China blocked Syria; states now associate R2P with Western interventionism; won't invoke it
What is the G20's advantage over the G7?
Includes China, India, Brazil, Russia — covers 85% of world GDP; G7 without these is politically incomplete for global economic issues
